ارتضي (form VIII)
# اُرْتُضِيَ (urtuḍiya) /ur.tu.dˤi.ja/: third-person masculine singular past passive of اِرْتَضَى (irtaḍā)
# اِرْتَضِي (irtaḍī) /ir.ta.dˤiː/: second-person feminine singular imperative of اِرْتَضَى (irtaḍā)
